title: DR1 shows the identification task on the hub only once the chosen species need identifiers; the frontend shows "Animal identification details" on every notification, including one with no commodity chosen at all.

finding.frontend: "Animal identification details" is a permanent row in the second section, present even on the hub for a notification where nothing has been imported yet — the fe-hub-no-commodity capture shows it, blocked, above a page with no commodities on it. The row is declared without the conditional flag its neighbours use (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow/task-rows.js:39-43), and only a conditional row is dropped when nothing it covers applies (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:93 and :108-110). The transit-countries row in the same task list is conditional and is correctly absent from all three captures.
finding.prototype: DR1 adds "Identification details" to the task list only when at least one selected species has identifier fields (app/routes.js:5776-5780, testing the rule at app/routes.js:1489-1493). The captured DR1 hub, with no species chosen, has no identification row: its second section holds Commodity details and Additional details and nothing else.
finding.difference: Mark the identification row conditional so it disappears when no commodity line needs identifiers, the way the transit-countries row already does. Without it a user importing a species with no identifier requirement is shown a task that can never be completed, and a user who has chosen nothing yet is shown a task about animals they have not named.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub for a notification with no commodity lines that does not list an animal identification row.
